Yesterday, as I was walking out of Mr. R's classroom for the last time, I called over my shoulder, "See you next year!" My friends told me I'm the asshole for this, but I don't think so. If my friends think it's mean, then perhaps I should consider their perspective. But I don't think I was being an asshole. I was just saying goodbye.
